items.content_html: OmniGate is a lightweight, headless API Gateway designed for indie hackers and mid-size SaaS startups. It provides drop-in request routing, rate limiting, and telemetry. Phase I focuses on building the core "Control Plane" (dashboard) and the "Data Plane" (edge proxy), allowing a user to generate an API key and route traffic through our edge nodes.

items.content_html: Prompt Guard is a lightweight browser extension for Chrome and Firefox that detects and masks sensitive information before it is sent to AI models. It performs local, real-time analysis of AI prompt fields, identifies PII and confidential data based on severity, and provides configurable masking and warning controls without storing user data.
